entities.name: Don Hogan Charles
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Don Hogan Charles was an American photographer. He was the first African-American staff photographer hired by The New York Times. In his four decades there, Charles photographed notable subjects including Coretta Scott King, John Lennon, Malcolm X and Muhammad Ali.
